project_scope.approved_headline: A sovereign optimization core designed to reduce dependency on proprietary commercial solvers.
prohibited_phrasing: Eliminates dependency on proprietary commercial solvers

refinery_model.approved_statement: Demonstration model — representative open-literature refinery data; not actual MRPL operational data. All units, yields and economics are representative engineering approximations. Numerically verified for the evaluated prototype model.

gpu_evidence.approved_primary_headline: On a physical NVIDIA RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, SOV-OPT demonstrated a 5.81x end-to-end acceleration over its CPU backend on the tested 10,000-variable true-sparse fixed-iteration PDHG workload (both backends executed 3,000 iterations to the same final objective).
gpu_evidence.approved_secondary_metric: 448.3x steady-state compute-loop timing ratio under the measured microbenchmark boundary (secondary metric, strictly NOT end-to-end solver speedup).
gpu_evidence.cloud_disclaimer: Physical GPU validation — not executed on Render. Render environment is CPU-only.

large_scale.approved_1m_statement: 1M-variable x 500K-row true-sparse GPU representation and SpMV were validated on the physical RTX 5050 (1,000,000 variables x 500,000 rows x 2,999,993 nonzeros; GPU upload ~108.0 ms, SpMV median ~0.178 ms, transpose SpMV median ~0.199 ms across 5 timed repetitions; representation stress test, not an optimization solve. Earlier Gate 20A CPU sparse representation stress test evaluated 2,500,000 nonzeros).
large_scale.approved_10m_guard_statement: A 10,000,000-variable ceiling is a configured architectural guard rail in the sparse data model subject to an explicit memory ceiling; it is not an empirically benchmarked solve size.

cutting_planes.approved_statement: Validated binary cover cuts improved root relaxation and reduced branch-and-bound nodes by 40–54.5% on targeted knapsack/oracle MILPs with 0 invalid cuts found under exhaustive binary-oracle validity testing on the tested small models (100% exhaustive binary-oracle validity agreement on the tested small models). Across the 38-instance authentic MIPLIB pass, results were unchanged overall (0 improved, 38 unchanged, 0 worsened, with zero correctness regressions). Gomory/GMI cuts were deferred because the current dual-simplex interface does not yet expose a proof-safe original-space tableau/basis mapping.

parallel_branch_and_bound.approved_primary_headline: SOV-OPT implements genuine intra-solve multi-process branch-and-bound. On a tested MILP workload, 1.94x matched-engine solve-to-completion speedup using 2 workers while exploring the identical 287-node search tree, with 97.0% measured parallel efficiency and preserving the same verified solution.
parallel_branch_and_bound.approved_secondary_search_effect: On another tested workload, parallel incumbent discovery and subtree pruning reduced total wall time by 3.60x; because the parallel search explored a different number of nodes (59 vs 321), this result is reported separately from pure worker-scaling evidence.
parallel_branch_and_bound.approved_miplib_statement: On selected authentic MIPLIB instances under equal fixed-time budgets, the 4-worker engine completed up to 39x as many branch-and-bound nodes. This is search-progress evidence, not solve-to-completion speedup.
parallel_branch_and_bound.approved_historical_multicore_statement: Process-level concurrent dispatch across independent instances (2.65x on 4 workers) — NOT parallel branch-and-bound.

trust_passport.approved_statement: The solver cannot simply declare a result optimal; an independent verification layer checks the returned solution against the original mathematical model before the result is accepted. LP/QP OPTIMAL_VERIFIED represents floating-point numerical KKT verification within declared tolerances. MILP represents a verified integer incumbent plus safe bound/tree-closure logic. SHA-256 fingerprints serve as reproducibility and integrity identifiers.
prohibited_phrasing: Formal proof of global optimality for all problem classes

farkas_lens.approved_statement: Diagnostic ranking — not a minimal IIS.
